title: Check yourself: Explicit criteria and the trust in a category

questions.stem: A review prompt says 'only report high-confidence issues', yet developers still dismiss most remarks about naming and layout. What fixes it?

options.text: Phrase the confidence threshold in stricter words
options.says: Ruled out because stricter wording of the same attitude still names no pattern, and such instructions "fail to improve precision".

options.text: Ask the reviewer to explain each remark at much greater length
options.says: Ruled out because a longer explanation leaves the categories unmentioned: "Most false positives are in the categories the prompt never mentioned".

options.text: Send fewer files to each review run
options.says: Ruled out because a smaller review changes the volume only, while a pattern is something "a reviewer can check a line against it".

options.text: Spell out which patterns to flag and which to leave alone
options.says: Naming the patterns to report and to skip is what changes the output.

origin.section: Explicit criteria and the trust in a category

questions.stem: One category of findings was dismissed in two thirds of its first twenty reviews, and developers have begun skipping the other remarks too. What does the guide recommend for that category?

options.text: Pause it while its prompt and examples improve
options.says: Disabling a high false-positive category while its prompt is improved restores trust in the rest.

options.text: Remove it from the criteria for good
options.says: Ruled out because "Deleting the category from the criteria loses the examples that the next attempt needs".

options.text: Keep it, with every finding marked low severity
options.says: Ruled out because the remarks would still be posted and dismissed, since "each dismissed comment lowers trust in the accepted ones".

options.text: Keep it, with a confidence score on each finding
options.says: Ruled out because "self-reported confidence is another vague instruction".

origin.section: Trust is measured, and a bad category is switched off
